FX confluence

Daily timeframe. Score 0-100 starts at 50 and adds four signals: day-on-day momentum (±12.5), RSI(14) (up to ±25), price vs 50-day EMA (±15) and 200-day Z-score (up to ±20); 60+ bullish, 40 or less bearish. Support and resistance: the 120-day high and low (strong) and levels 40% of the way from price to each (moderate). Same formula as the original FX Macro Confluence engine. Pairs from Yahoo Finance (FRED fallback); XAUUSD uses COMEX gold futures. Latest close 2026-10-22.
